elements.name: Content Placeholder 9
elements.text:
M3 and eResearch
Reuse the working cluster connection. Confirm CI-led project access and limits. Use CPU baselines, a GPU pilot and HPC training or drop-ins.

elements.name: Content Placeholder 10
elements.text:
DREAM and Turner
Start with a public DREAM subset. Seek a sleep/EEG adviser through a supervisor. A Monash-hosted collection is not automatically Monash-collected data.

elements.name: Content Placeholder 9
elements.text:
Biomedical Imaging
MBI lists EEG and simultaneous EEG-fMRI support. Treat new recordings as optional, with facility training, ethics, bookings and a budget.

elements.name: Content Placeholder 10
elements.text:
IT and DeepNeuron
The IT EEG representation-learning project is a supervision lead. DeepNeuron offers a possible AI/HPC student community. Places and collaboration need confirmation.
